label: For Each
description: Run another workflow once for every item in a list: a real loop. Each run receives the item as a variable.

inputs.name: items
inputs.label: Items
inputs.description: A list (or JSON array, or one item per line).

inputs.name: variables
inputs.label: Variables
inputs.description: Object of extra named values passed to every run.

inputs.name: workflow
inputs.label: Workflow Override
inputs.description: Workflow id or name, overriding the configured one.

outputs.name: results
outputs.label: Results
outputs.description: List with each run's 'result' return, in item order.

outputs.name: all
outputs.label: All Returns
outputs.description: List with each run's full returns object.

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: Error
outputs.description: Error message if the step failed. Wire it to handle failures yourself; leave it unwired and the node fails visibly instead.
